# Joyn

> > Joyn is Germany's leading streaming platform offering live TV, media libraries, series, films, and documentaries from SAT.1, MOVIEDOME, HGTV, Kabel Eins Doku, and other channels.

Joyn provides on-demand and live streaming of German television content, including international anime series like Naruto, reality shows, crime dramas, cooking competitions, and children's programming. The platform aggregates content from multiple German broadcasters and offers both free and premium subscription tiers.

## Key Topics

- Streaming
- German TV
- Mediathek (Media Library)

## Media Libraries & Live TV

- [Naruto Stream: Schaue die Kult-Anime-Serie live online auf Joyn](https://www.joyn.de/live-tv/naruto): Live stream Naruto anime: Follow ninja Naruto Uzumaki's adventures on Joyn
- [MOVIEDOME Mediathek - Ganze Folgen und Filme auf Joyn schauen](https://www.joyn.de/mediatheken/moviedome): MOVIEDOME media library: Stream films and series on Joyn anytime
- [HGTV Mediathek - Ganze Folgen und Filme auf Joyn schauen](https://www.joyn.de/mediatheken/hgtv): HGTV media library: Home & garden shows including Property Brothers on Joyn
- [Alle Kabel Eins Doku Sendungen bei Joyn | Mediathek & Live-Stream](https://www.joyn.de/mediatheken/kabel-eins-doku): Kabel Eins Doku media library: Documentaries and reports streaming on Joyn
